Subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity & throughput targets (Atlas AI)

Hi Ava / Atlas team,

Thanks again for the pilot conversations — excited to get the MAP (mutual action plan) started so we can align on capacity, throughput targets, and a clear close timeline for the dedicated GPU pool. Proposed objectives for the kickoff: 

- Introduce stakeholders and owners (redwood + Atlas roles)
- Confirm workload profile (model variants, sequence lengths, QPS / tokens per minute targets)
- Agree on test plan and pass/fail criteria for throughput and latency SLOs
- Outline procurement and contract milestones and an anticipated close date

Attachments: I attached our MAP template and a capacity worksheet so you can drop in your numbers ahead of the call.

Proposed time: Thu Oct 9, 2026 11:00 - 11:45 PT (happy to shift if needed).

Ask for this kickoff: can Athena (engineering lead) or Samir (infrastructure) join to validate the traffic pattern and SLOs? Also please share an initial estimate of target sustained tokens/sec (or p99 latency target) so we can size the GPU pool and recommend quantization/instance types.

I'll own the MAP coordination and follow-up items. Monica will run the capacity tests once we have model artifacts and Aditya will coordinate pricing/commits.

Thanks,

--
Logan Wright
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Logan — thanks for the note and the materials. 11:00 PT works for our team. Samir (cc'd) will join from infra and I've looped procurement for timeline visibility. A few quick items from our side: 

- We'll aim to provide a first-cut workload profile by EOD today (typical seq length ~512, expected 300 reqs/min initially; target p99 generation latency ~1.2s for the main prompt).
- We have two model variants in scope: gpt-family-2-13b (baseline) and a client-finetuned 7b (fast path).
- Procurement asks for an initial quote and the required procurement SLAs (data handling, retention, audit logs).

Please confirm whether we should include model weights or only inference containers for Monica's tests. Also we prefer a 6–8 week timeline to go from kickoff -> PoC -> committed Dedicated capacity if the performance targets are met.

Looking forward to the call — sending over a couple quick notes in-line below.

Adding a quick ops note from the Redwood test/validation side: 

- I'll own the capacity validation and will need either the model artifacts (weights + tokenizer) or a reproducible inference container (preferred: container + model signature). If Atlas can only provide an API endpoint for early validation, that's fine for latency checks but won't let us measure per-GPU throughput exactly.
- Proposed test plan (high level) — sustained 30 minute runs at target QPS, 3 ramp cycles, and a final p99 latency sweep. Pass criteria: sustained throughput within 10% of target and p99 <= agreed threshold.
- I'll prepare a short test harness (script + perf dashboard) and share the invocation steps before the PoC.

I've added a short checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cMAP-AtlasAI — please drop any sample prompts and a small representative dataset (redacted) there.

Cheers,
